story_zh: 凌晨三點，電梯停在不存在的十三樓。門開了，走廊盡頭站著另一個我。它緩緩抬起頭，對我說：你終於回來了。就在這時，電梯門上的倒影裡，我發現自己根本沒有臉。
story_en: At three in the morning, the elevator stopped on a floor that didn't exist. When the doors opened, another version of me stood at the end of the hall. It slowly raised its head and whispered, You finally came back. Then I looked at my reflection in the elevator doors. I had no face.
